howto.name: PrivaTools compresses via FFmpeg
howto.text: FLAC is lossless: the audio is bit-for-bit identical to the WAV, typically 40-60% smaller.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. FLAC is lossless: the audio is bit-for-bit identical to the WAV and typically 40–60% smaller. This is the one audio conversion here that costs you nothing in quality.

faq.a: Yes — FLAC compresses WAV losslessly, typically to 40–60% of the size with zero quality loss. It's the ideal way to archive uncompressed audio.
FLAC is widely supported on desktops and modern players, but not on every older or portable device. Keep WAV or use WAV→MP3 for those.
